content: Shauli kangunhyubhalila Yesu
Mumanjubha agho Shauli, kakiyonjokeha hiyighoho hya kuakoma afwasi bha Bambo. Kakinng'endela Ndundame Nkulu

naywo kakinnyupa Ndundame Nkulu kampeghe lihamba lya kummanyiha mu nyumba ya kutundamilila Akaayahudi akwo ku Dameski, ngati handa pakaabhona alume ebu adala bhaaghutughila uhyubhalilo aghwo kahotole kabhakamule na kuaghegha ku Yelusalemu.
Peni pakabheghite mu mwanja ghwake, ugheghela na kuhika ku Dameski; pindulu lung'ali kuhuma kubhwelo lukimmulika mbande hyoha.
Kakighwegha pahi na kakiyihwa lilobhe palikinng'ombela, “Shauli, Shauli! Kiyaha niki ghungumbamanda?”
Shauli kakikonya, “Ghwenga ndo ghani Bambo?” Na lila lilobhe likiyanga, “Nenga ndo Yesu yula yughummbamanda.
Hino ghuyinuke na ghuyingile kumbwani, akwo kabhegha mundu ghwa kughughombela gha kughatenda.”
Bhala bhandu bhaabheghite mumwanja ghumu na Sauli bhakinyamala jii, kiyaha bhakiliyihwa lila lilobhi, peni bhakinmona ng'obhe mundu ywakalongela.
Shauli kakiyima pala pahi na kakiyigha kughahughula meho ghake, peni kakihotola ng'obhe kubhona kyoheli kila. Ndo bhakinkamula kibhoko na bhakinnongoha mbaka ku Dameski.
Naywo Shauli kwa manjubha mandatu kakibha ywangalola, kakilyegha ng'obhe hangi kunywegha kyoheli.
Akwo ku Damasikati kakibhegha nhundwa ghwa Kilisito yumu lihina lyake Anania. Pakabheghite mu mabhono, Bambo kakinkema, “Anania!” Anania kakiyitika. “Mwika Bambo.”
Bambo kakinng'ombela, “Ghubhuke ghughende ku njila yiikemwa njila ng'ololeho, na mu lubhagha lwa Yuda, ghukankonye mundu ghwa ku Taliso, lihina lyake Shauli. Hinu kangunnyupa Chapanga,
na mumabhono ghake Shauli kammona mundu ywakakemwa Anania kanguhika na kunnyabhikila mabhoko ngati kahotole kubhona kangi.”
Peni Anania kakiyanga, “Bambo, nyihwa mihalo ya mundu aywo kuhuma kwa bhandu atangalo, nyihwa ya kya mihakatahu yakabhatendelite bhandu bhako bha ku Yerusalemu.
Naywo kahika apa pa Damesikati pakibhegha na makakala gha kuhuma kwa hilongohi bha andundame ngati kabhakamule bhandu bhoha bhaalikambuka lihina lyako.”
Peni Bambo kakinghombela Anania, “Ghughende! Kiyaha mundu ayu nunhaghula, ngati kalilandamihe lihina lyangu kwa bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Akaayahudi na muabhatwa bhabhe na kwa Akaaisilaeli.
Nenga nimwene ndammoneha yiinnogha kubamandika kwa kya lihina lyangu.”

Hino Anania kakighenda, kakiyingila mula munyumba yakyabheghite Shauli. Mbole kakinnyabhikila mabhoko kunu paakilongela, “Nlongo Sauli, Bambo Yesu ywakakubwitukilite pa njila paghubheghite mu kuhika apa, ndo ywakanlaghilite kwa ghwenga ngati ghumokole kubhona kangi na ghulongohwe na Nhuki ghwa Chapanga.”
Kamu hilibhi handa mapalapatilo gha homba ghakinponeka kuhuma mu meho ghake, na kakihotola kubhona kangi. Kakiyima na kakibatiswa.
Mbole ya kulyegha hilyo, makakala ghake ghakimmuyila kangi. Sauli kangulandamiha ku Damesiki Shauli kakitama mu manjubha gha mandina na akaafuasi ghwa akwo ku Damesiki.
Kamu kakiyingila mu nyumba ya kutundamila Akaayahudi na kualandamiha bhandu kukita Yesu ndo Mwana ghwa Chapanga.

Bhandu bhoha bhannyihwite Shauli bhakikangacha na bhakilongela, “Bhuli, ayu ndo mundu yula ng'obhe, ywakabheghite kanguakoma bhandu bhaanhyubhalilite Yesu kula ku Yerusalemu? Na kangi kakihika apa ngati kaakamule na kuaghegha kwa mandundame akulu?”
Hinu Shauli kakighendelela kubha nhwadali na kubhabhoneha Akaayahudi bha ku Demsiki kukita Yesu ndo Kilisito.
Mbole ya manjubha matangalo, Akaayahudi bhakikwemukana ngati aghombane ya kya kunkoma Shauli.
Peni nnando ghwabhe ghukimanyika kanongola kwa Shauli. Akaayahudi bhakibha mu kupingikiha milyango hyoha ya kuyingila pa mbwani, pamuhi na pakilo ngati ahotole kunkoma.
Peni afwasi bhake bhakintola pakilo na kunhuluha paakibha mulukapu kukindila palilanga lubheghite pa kindupa kya kitami.
Shauli kangubhuya ku Yelusalemu
Shauli pakahikite ku Yelusalemu kakiyigha kulilunga na ahundwa bha Yesu, peni bhoha bhakinntila, kiyaha bhakihyubhalila ng'obhe kukita ywene kakibhegha nfwasi.

Apwo Balinaba kakihika kuntola na kakinghegha kwa andumitumi. Kakialubhulila kya bhula Sauli pakammonite Bambo, na kya bhula Bambo pakalongilite naywo na kya bhula pakalandamihite kwa ukangamalo kwa lihina lya Yesu akwo ku Dameski.
Hinu Shauli kakililunga nabho, kakityanga ku Yelusalemu paakilandamiha lilagho lya Bambo kwa lihina lya Yesu kwa ukangamalo.
Kakighombana na Akaayahudi bha Kiyunani, peni bhombe bhakipala kunkoma.
Bhala bhanhyubhalilite Kilisito paayuhwite nhalo aghwo bhakintola mbaka ku Kaisalia, na bhakinneka kaghende ku Taliso.

Ndo mu manjubha agho ngwemuko ya bhandu bhaanhyubhalilite Kilisito bhakibha na uhihimilo mu Uyahudi hyoha, na Galilaya na Samalia. Bhakighendelela kutengeleheka na kunnyitikila Bambo na mbalango yabhe yikiyonjokeheka kwa utangwo ghwa Nhuki ghwa Chapanga.
Ainea kangulamihwa
Petili pakabheghite mu mwanja kughenda kwoheli kula, lisiku limu kakighenda kuatyangila bhandu bha Chapanga bhaatamiteghe ku Lida.
Akwo kakinkolela mundu yumu ywakakemitwe Ainea, aywo kakibha nlelebhalo kwa ngungwa nane kya nga kuyinuka pa ulili.
Hinu, Petili kaking'ombela, “Ainea, Yesu Kilisito kaghulamiha, ghuyinuke na ghuyalule likahe lyakwo.” Kamu, Ainea kakiyinuka.
Bhandu bhaatamite ku Lida na luluchi lya ku Shaloni bhoha bhakinkilibhukila Bambo.

Akwo ku Yopa kakibha nhyubhalila yumu ndala lihina lyake Tabita, kwa Kiyunani Dolkasi fwambulo yake nnyma yunakukemwa mbabhala, nndala aywo kakibha kangutenda gha maha na kakiatanga bhandu kapukwa manjubha ghoha.
Mumanjubha agho kukibha kakilwala na kuyomoka. Bhandu bhakighuyoha mmili ghwake, na bhakighughonjeha ku kyumba kya ku ligholofa.

Yopa kukibha ugheghele na ku Lida, bhandu bhaanhyubhalilite Kilisito paayuhwite kukita Petili kabhegha akwo, bhakialaghila bhandu abhili kwa Petili ngati bhakanyupe, “Ketaketa ghuhike kya nga kukabhalila.”

Hinu Petili kakilongohana nabho, pakahikite bhakinnongoha mbaka ku kyumba kya kunane ya ligholofa pakaghonjehitwe Dolikasi. Adala alekwa atangalo bhakintindila Petili kunu paalila na kunnangiha maghwanda matandamahu na mapinda ghangi ghaatalaswite na Dolkasi pakabeghite na ubhumi.
Petili kakiabhuha bhoha panji, kakichutama mayughwa, pakiyupa. Mbole kakighulola ghula ntumba pakilongela, “Tabitha ghuyumuke.” Naywo Tabita kakihughula meho ghake, na pakanmonite Petili, kakitama.
Petili kakinkamula kibhoko kakinnyinula, ndo kakiakema bhaanhyubhalilite Yesu na bhala adala alekwa, mbole kakiakamuha kwa bhene kunu pakakeka.
Mihalo ayi yikikwila kwoha ku Yopa na bhandu atangalo bhakinhyubhalila Bambo.
Petili kakitama ku Yopa mu manjubha matangalo papamu na Simoni ntendehi ghwa kutendekeha hilibhi hya mayula.
